item.title: Company Values and Global Presence in Imaging Supplies
item.description:
Company Overview and Vision
#

General Plastic Industrial Co., Ltd. (GPI ) stands as a leading manufacturer and supplier in the imaging supplies sector. Established in 1978, GPI is headquartered at 50, Tzu-Chiang Rd., Wu-Chi District, Taichung City, Taiwan 43546. With a workforce of over 500 employees, the company has achieved a revenue milestone of 60 million US dollars as of December 31, 2017.
